bibliographic.title: The Impossible Conversation
bibliographic.author: justsharyn
bibliographic.description:
You've prepared for this conversation. You've rehearsed your lines, cooked up whatever possible scenarios could happen, thought of what they would say.
You're ready. This time, you'll make them stay.

Content warning: Friends can wound with the deepest cuts. If this strikes someplace tender, tread carefully.
Created for the 2024 Dialogue Jam on Twine. Constructive feedback appreciated!
